name: Pain Catastrophizing Scale
description: 13-item self-report scale measuring the degree to which people catastrophize about pain. Three subscales: Rumination, Magnification, Helplessness.
copyright: Free for clinical/research use (Sullivan et al. 1995)
shirleySays: ICC 0.92. Cronbach α 0.87–0.92. MDC: ~9 pts. MCID: ~9 pts. Three subscales: Rumination, Magnification, Helplessness. Validated in chronic pain, LBP, fibromyalgia, CRPS, surgical pre-op, cancer, RA. Strong predictor of pain disability and treatment non-response.
